name: Avatar
description: A circular person avatar: the photo when there is one, initials on a sunken surface when there is not (the initials sit underneath and the photo overlays them). Owns its full style — references tokens only; resize via the Ref's style.
whenToUse: Represent a person or account anywhere a face belongs (a review, an account row, an assignee). Compose via a Ref, mapping image/initials/name to host fields. For the voice-call assistant avatar with live rings, use agent-avatar instead.
